answer: Answer: 221 genes are significantly differentially expressed (BH FDR < 0.05) relative to JBX1 in at least one single mutant (ΔlasI or ΔrhlI) but are NOT differentially expressed in the ΔlasIΔrhlI double mutant (primary design ~Strain with DESeq2-style pipeline; per-condition counts: ΔlasI/97 = 1131, ΔrhlI/98 = 1532, double/99 = 3205; union of singles = 2124). Sensitivity: 282 under ~Media + Strain; 232 without independent filtering; 1894 if the double-mutant label were flipped to strain 98. IMPORTANT DEVIATION DISCLOSED: actual DESeq2 (R) could not be provisioned in this runtime (no R binary, no rpy2, no conda, apt unusable non-root, pip has no network), so the analysis used a from-scratch Python implementation of the DESeq2 algorithm (PyDESeq2-equivalent), validated on simulated ground-truth data.
